address: 27 Philadelphia St, Quakers Friars, Broadmead, Bristol,BS1 3BZ
bio: Situated on the top floor of Harvey Nichols Bristol, the restaurant is the perfect place to enjoy Afternoon Tea while admiring the view of Quakers Friars from the floor-to-ceiling windows.  The Traditional Afternoon Tea menu features a selection of savouries, including Scottish smoked salmon & dill cream cheese sandwich and egg & chive mayonnaise vol-au-vent.  Scones are served with jam and clotted cream, followed by a selection of sweet treats, including a rich dark chocolate and cardamom torte with raspberries. Enjoy unlimited hot drinks from a selection of teas, infusions and coffees.  Afternoon Tea is served every day and costs £35 per person, or £45 with a glass of Champagne.
